comparison.objective: Join two 2×2 blocks with exactly two adjacent studs engaged and verify the cantilevered joint; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Offset stud alignment, partial press-fit engagement, force control, and cantilevered lift verification versus tool insertion, fine rotary tuning, counterholding, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly two adjacent studs must engage and retain the unsupported lower block; candidate instead requires two safe impact cycles and lock stability. Fit-force thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Partial-overlap press-fit assembly tests a distinct geometric and retention skill.
